justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Clinical exercise physiology delivers measurable fitness and cardiovascular risk improvements; CEP vs non-CEP outcomes not studied.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: ACSM exam plus degree and supervised experience requirements; moderate cost.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in cardiac rehab, diabetes management, and chronic disease programs; limited in standard PT/OT.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: EP billing limited in most settings; some cardiac rehab programs bill EP services; primarily institutional salary-based.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Moderate demand in hospital-based fitness, cardiac rehab support, and employee wellness programs.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients value structured, science-based exercise prescription.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Cardiac/metabolic and longevity-oriented clients increasingly pay cash for clinical exercise programming.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Supports moderate premium in performance/longevity niches, though EP brand is less consumer-known.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Uncommon credential among PTs; differentiates in cardiopulm/metabolic markets.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Programs can be templated and delivered by staff EPs — decent leverage.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Limited direct consumer recognition outside cardiac-rehab world.
justifications.business.efficiency: Requires graduate-level coursework and clinical hours — non-trivial path.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Respected for cardiopulm content; useful adjunct credential for PT faculty.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: ACSM ecosystem is publication-rich, especially in exercise physiology and cardiometabolic disease.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly relevant to cardiopulm and exercise prescription curricula.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Underlying exercise physiology literature is among the strongest in health science.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally preferred in cardiopulm faculty roles but not commonly required.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Reasonable cost; meaningful time investment for the academic credit it provides.
